algorithm.malformed: Ignore an individually malformed range; if no acceptable exact supported range remains, use Storefront default.
algorithm.mandatory_content_failure: After Storefront default, missing mandatory localized fields excludes the list item and makes detail return the approved uniform Product not-found outcome.
algorithm.matching: Case-insensitive BCP47 canonical comparison with exact supported-tag equality only; no language-subtag truncation.
algorithm.parse: Parse comma-separated concrete BCP47 language ranges; a missing q-value is 1.0.
algorithm.priority: Sort by descending q-value, preserving original header order for ties.
algorithm.q_zero: q=0 ranges are explicitly unacceptable and never selected.
algorithm.resolved_locale_output: Return the resolved locale in the Content-Language response header for list, detail and uniform detail not-found.
algorithm.wildcard: Wildcard does not select an arbitrary supported locale; proceed to Storefront default.

boundaries: fr-CA;q=0.8,en-US;q=0.8 selects the first supported header member.
en;q=1 does not match en-US unless en itself is supported.
*;q=1 and malformed-only input use Storefront default.
selected_option.impact: Deterministic and aligned with the accepted exact-match rule without adding language-family fallback.
selected_option.summary: Parse Accept-Language deterministically by quality and header order, accept exact supported tags only, then use Storefront default.
selected_option.tradeoff: Callers requesting only a related language tag may receive Storefront default instead of a same-language regional locale.
